tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// shākya'i rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs pa bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig byang chub shing dbang drung du bdud sde dpung bcas sa dang mkha' la kun khyab cing*// rdo rje mdung thung dang ni 'khor lo me dang ri dang gangs ri'i phreng bas char 'bebs pa// rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul byed stobs ldan me tog mda' can byang chub bzlog phyir brtson pa na// byams pa'i thugs kyis legs par pham mdzad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang brnyes de la mgos phyag 'tshal// khyod kyis gzhan gyi don slad du// bsam dang sbyor ba phun tshogs pas// byang chub dam par thugs bskyed tshe// sa yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos// sbyin dang tshul khrims legs bsgrubs shing*// bzod dang brtson 'grus goms par mdzad// bsam gtan shes rab mthar phyin pas// pha rol phyin rdzogs khyod phyag 'tshal// 'gro mgon dang po bltams pa na// 'jig rten mkhas pa thams cad dga'// bdud rnams shin tu dogs pa skyes// mu stegs byed pa mtha' dag skrag /de slad khyod kyi bstan pa ni// nyi ma'i 'od bzhin phrin las mnga'// rnam pa kun du mi bslu ba'i// rtsa lag khyod la bdag skyabs mchi// khyod kyi gsung rab seng ge'i sgra// lhar bcas 'jig rten bsgrags pa na// tshangs dang khyab 'jug lkugs par gyur// lha yi bla ma wa ltar zhum// thub pa rkang mig grog mkhar dang*// drang srong rgyas pa gnas 'jog sogs// grags pa thob pa de dag kun// chos kyis pham mdzad khyod la 'dud// khyod kyis byang chub mchog brnyes nas// 'gro ba'i don mdzad ngo mtshar che// srid pa'i sred las ma grol bar// sku srog btang bas ba spu ldang*// nyid kyi sku srog mi gzigs par// khyed la phan par bya'o zhes// mgon med bdag cag rjes gzung ba// mgon po khyod la bdag skyabs mchi// rgyal bas bdud sde btul ba dang*// mu stegs ma lus pham mdzad dang*// nyan thos slob ma grangs med bkrol// rgyal sras dam pa lung bstan mdzad// de 'dra'i legs tshogs mthong ba rnams// khyod kyi yon tan don gnyer bas// byang chub slad du 'jug pa bdag

/slar yang khyod la bdag skyabs mchi// khyod kyi sras ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs// slob ma sha ra dwa ti'i bu// byams pa rgyal tshab dam par mdzad// sems shes su zhig the tshom za// khyod kyi yon tan smos ci 'tshal// sras kyi yon tan mthong bas khums// skya rengs shar ba'i gzi brjid kyis// padmo'i gnyen gyi 'od zer go /ji lta ba dang ji snyed chos// khyod kyis rnam pa kun brnyes pas// bzhed pa'i phrin las don bzhin du// grub pa khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal// de ltar 'gro pa'i bla ma shākya'i rigs// bu ram shing pa'i gdung rgyud las 'khrungs pa// bcom ldan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bstod pa yis// 'gro bas kun mkhyen myur du thob par shog /bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bco lnga pa/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍ-i tas lha sa'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
